Scene 1: Grand professional packaging conceals an absurdly trivial secret. At left a nervous ordinary adult hunches over a smartphone, shielding the screen with a hand; the phone has a simple row of EXACTLY SIX password bullet dots, not digits. At right three pompous formally dressed experts in suits and laboratory coats ceremonially unveil a large elaborately engineered vault with several open concentric mechanical doors. Inside the vault is a small plush-lined presentation box, also open. The box contains ONE enormous bold RED integer '4', resting upright like a precious object. The experts look solemn and self-satisfied; the ordinary person's side-eye carries disbelief. Make the nested vault, small box and lonely 4 instantly readable. Keep the 4 visually dominant. No other readable text anywhere. The joke is expensive ceremony and professional appearance surrounding a private key whose integer is 4. Do not imply the PIN and cryptographic key are identical systems.
